integrity: The exact proof is contained in RESULT.md. verify.py is a standalone standard-library exhaustive finite cross-check. No independent validation or publication-priority certification is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Applies to labeled rectangular rook graphs with two factor orders at least two. Exact optimizer counts/classification are asserted only when the factor orders differ by one. Finite enumerations supplement but do not replace the general proof; unindexed prior equivalents remain possible.
title: A one-step aspect-ratio anomaly in Grundy total domination of rook graphs
